stories.title: Kennedy Center removes outdoor sculpture amid Trump transition dispute
new_facts: New story: Kennedy Center began removing outdoor sculpture 'Blue,' added in 2019, after Trump's takeover of the center.
Identifies sculpture 'Blue' as work of artist Joel Shapiro; publishes photos of it being wrapped, cut apart and hauled away.
Reports Kennedy Center grounds are set to be renamed after President Trump.
Announces temporary road closures and restrictions around the Kennedy Center during the sculpture's removal.
Reveals internal documents obtained by The New York Times showing the sculpture was targeted for removal early in Trump's second term; describes crane operation by National Park Service.
stories.line: Kennedy Center is removing an outdoor sculpture after pressure from the Trump transition, triggering debate over arts funding control.
